title: The docs map sends a coord hook change to tools.md, which states the hook's output bound
goal: kb/_self/map.csv maps .claude/hooks/coord_hook.py to kb/_self/tools.md, so an item that changes the hook's output gets tools.md in its touches at planning time

run:
import csv,sys
r=[x for x in csv.reader(open('kb/_self/map.csv')) if len(x)>1 and x[0]=='kb/_self/tools.md' and x[1] in ('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py','.claude/hooks/*')]
print(r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)

notes: SP-w6amecjt close: ST-46kxzalv's worker stopped on tools.md (the hook prints at most ten lines) outside its touches; the orchestrator widened them on the branch and resumed the worker.
